parts.text: {"section_id":"sec09","title":"Execution Roadmap","phase":"Value Story","summary":"Year-by-year execution sequencing aligned to value realization and modernization waves.","narrative":["The execution roadmap is structured to balance immediate operational stabilization with long-term architectural transformation. The sequence prioritizes the establishment of foundational platform services and observability before scaling modernization waves across the retail estate.","Investment is front-loaded to accelerate the transition to a target delivery mix of 55% offshore by Year 3, leveraging delivery centers in Bengaluru and Hyderabad for engineering scale and Guadalajara for nearshore product operations.","Execution is governed by a strict holiday code freeze from mid-November to early January to protect customer-facing platforms during peak retail seasons, ensuring that modernization activities do not compromise seasonal revenue."],"kpi_cards":[],"tables":[],"cards":[],"chart":null,"matrix":null,"timeline":[{"year":"Year 1","phase":"Foundation","investment":"$31.35M","business_value":"$5.78M","milestone":"Stabilize identity, pricing, and observability foundations; initiate Wave 1 transition."},{"year":"Year 2","phase":"Acceleration","investment":"$25.08M","business_value":"$17.78M","milestone":"Launch modernization factory waves and expand shared engineering platform services."},{"year":"Year 3","phase":"Scale","investment":"$20.90M","business_value":"$32.79M","milestone":"Achieve target 55% offshore delivery mix and scale cloud migration."},{"year":"Year 4","phase":"Optimization","investment":"$16.72M","business_value":"$45.66M","milestone":"Consolidate legacy estates and industrialize ongoing optimization."},{"year":"Year 5","phase":"Optimization","investment":"$10.45M","business_value":"$54.68M","milestone":"Mature the steady-state operating model and lock in innovation-budget shift."}],"delivery_cards":[],"callouts":["Wave 1 prioritizes customer identity, pricing, returns, and observability foundations before major order and supply-chain rewrites.","Platform engineering capacity is shared across commerce, loyalty, and supply-chain programs to avoid parallel peak demand."],"fact_refs":["investment_by_year_usd","yearly_business_value_usd"],"evidence_refs":[],"required_widgets":["roadmap-timeline"]}
